example: አሁንም ሞከረው (He tried it again)

title: To support / back up
example: ሃሳቡን ደገፉት (They supported his idea)

title: To oppose / resist
example: ውሳኔውን ተቃወመ (He opposed the decision)

title: To influence
example: በሰዎቹ ላይ ተፅዕኖ አደረገ (He influenced the people)

title: To inspire / motivate
example: ተማሪዎቹን አበረታታቸው (He inspired the students)

title: To express / declare
example: ስሜቱን ገለጸ (He expressed his feelings)

title: To claim / pretend
example: እንደታመመ አስመሰለ (He pretended to be sick)

title: To adapt / adjust
example: ከአዲሱ ቦታ ጋር ተላመደ (He adapted to the new place)

title: To abandon / leave behind
example: ቤቱን ትቶ ሄደ (He abandoned the house)

title: To organize / structure
example: ስራውን በጥሩ ሁኔታ አቀናጀ (He organized the work well)

title: To evaluate / assess
example: ውጤቱን ገመገሙት (They evaluated the performance)

title: To promote / elevate
example: ምርቱን አስተዋወቁ (They promoted the product)

title: To obstacle / hinder
example: ስራውን አደናቀፈው (He obstructed the work)

title: To confuse / mislead
example: ህዝቡን አታለሉ (They misled the public)

title: To pause / suspend
example: ጨዋታው ተገደ (The game was suspended)

title: To halt / stop temporarily
example: ስራውን አቋረጠው (He stopped the work)

title: To complete within time
example: ፕሮጀክቱን በጊዜ ጨረሱ (They completed the project on time)

title: To flaws / identify defects
example: የስራውን ጉድለት አየ (He saw the flaws of the work)

title: To demonstrate / display
example: ችሎታውን አሳየ (He demonstrated his ability)

title: To comply / align
example: ከደንቡ ጋር ተስማሙ (They complied with the rule)

title: To give / grant
example: እድል ሰጡት (They gave him an opportunity)

title: To receive / take over
example: ኃላፊነቱን ተረከበ (He took over responsibility)

title: To be surrounded / encircled
example: ቦታው ተከቧል (The place is surrounded)

title: Services
example: ጥሩ አገልግሎት ሰጡ (They provided good services)

title: Intended / Targeted
example: የታለመው ግብ ተመታ (The intended goal was achieved)

title: To investigate / examine in detail
example: ጉዳዩን አጣሩት (They investigated the matter)

title: To recommend / advise
example: ጥሩ ምክር ሰጠኝ (He gave me good advice)

title: To coordinate / mobilize
example: ህዝቡን አስተባበሩ (They coordinated the people)

title: To accomplish / fulfill
example: ተልዕኮውን ፈጸመ (He accomplished the mission)

title: Thank you
example: እጅግ አመሰግናለሁ ለ እርዳታህ (Thank you very much for your help)

title: Please
example: እባክህ እርዳኝ (Please help me)

title: You're welcome
example: ምንም አይደለም፣ ደስ ብሎኛል (You're welcome, my pleasure)

title: Hello
example: ሰላም! እንዴት ነህ? (Hello! How are you?)

title: Good morning
example: እንደምን አደርክ ወንድሜ! (Good morning my brother!)

title: Good night
example: ደህና እደር(Good night!)

title: Good evening
example: መልካም ምሽት ይሁንልህ (Have a good evening)

title: Goodbye
example: ደህና ሁን፣ ነገ እንገናኛለን (Goodbye, see you tomorrow)

title: Welcome
example: ወደ ቤታችን እንኳን ደህና መጣህ (Welcome to our home)

title: How are you?
example: እንዴት ነህ? ደህና ነህ? (How are you? Are you good?)

title: I am fine
example: እኔ ደህና ነኝ፣ አመሰግናለሁ (I am fine, thank you)

title: What is your name?
amharic: ስምህ ማን ነው? / ስምሽ ማን ነው?
example: ስምህ ማን ነው ወንድሜ? (What is your name, brother?)

title: My name is...
example: ስሜ አሊ ይባላል (My name is Ali)

title: Nice to meet you
example: ስለተገናኘን በጣም ደስ ብሎኛል (Nice to meet you very much)

title: Yes / No
example: አዎ፣ እፈልጋለሁ (Yes, I want to)

title: OK / Alright
example: እሺ፣ ችግር የለውም (OK, no problem)

title: Excuse me / Sorry
example: ይቅርታ፣ አልሰማሁህም (Sorry, I didn't hear you)

title: No problem
example: ችግር የለውም፣ ወንድሜ (No problem, my brother)

title: I don't know
example: እኔ አላውቅም፣ ሌላ ሰው ጠይቅ (I don't know, ask someone else)

title: I understand
example: አሁን ገብቶኛል፣ አመሰግናለሁ (Now I understand, thank you)

title: I don't understand
example: እባክህ ደግመህ ንገረኝ፣ አልገባኝም (Please tell me again, I don't understand)

title: Where is...?
example: ሽ his ሸንት ቤት የት ነው? (Where is the bathroom?)

title: How much is this?
example: ይህ ሸሚዝ ስንት ነው? (How much is this shirt?)

title: Help me!
example: እባክህ እርዳኝ፣ ችግር ላይ ነኝ (Please help me, I am in trouble)

title: I am hungry
example: በጣም ርቦኛል፣ ምግብ እፈልጋለሁ (I am very hungry, I want food)

title: I am thirsty
example: ተጠምቻለሁ፣ ውሃ ስጠኝ (I am thirsty, give me water)

title: I am tired
example: ዛሬ በጣም ደክሞኛል (I am very tired today)

title: I want...
example: ውሃ እፈልጋለሁ (I want water)

title: I don't want...
example: ምንም አልፈልግም፣ አመሰግናለሁ (I don't want anything, thank you)

title: What time is it?
example: እባክህ ንገረኝ፣ ስንት ሰዓት ነው? (Please tell me, what time is it?)

title: Where are you going?
example: ወዴት እየሄድክ ነው አሁን? (Where are you going now?)

title: Where are you from?
example: አንተ ከየት ነህ? (Where are you from?)

title: I am from...
example: እኔ ከኢትዮጵያ ነኝ (I am from Ethiopia)

title: What are you doing?
example: አሁን ምን እያደረግክ ነው? (What are you doing now?)

title: What happened?
example: እዚያ ምን ተፈጠረ? (What happened there?)

title: What's new?
example: ሰላም! ምን አዲስ ነገር አለ? (Hello! What's new?)

title: Nothing new
example: ምንም አዲስ ነገር የለም፣ ሁሉ ነገር ሰላም ነው (Nothing new, everything is peaceful)

title: See you later
somali: Pee intii dambe / Is aragti dambe
example: አሁን እሄዳለሁ፣ በኋላ እንገናኛለን (I am going now, see you later)

title: See you tomorrow
somali: Billee is aragti / Is aragti beri
example: ደህና እደር፣ ነገ እንገናኛለን (Good night, see you tomorrow)

title: Have a good day
example: ደህና ሁን፣ መልካም ቀን ይሁንልህ (Goodbye, have a good day)

title: Bon appétit / Enjoy your meal
example: መልካም ምግብ ይሁንላችሁ (Enjoy your meal everyone)

title: Have a safe trip
example: መልካም መንገድ ይሁንልህ (Have a safe trip)

title: Good luck
example: ለፈተናው መልካም ዕድል (Good luck for the exam)

title: Congratulations
example: እንኳን ደስ አለህ ለምረቃህ! (Congratulations on your graduation!)

title: Happy Birthday
example: መልካም ልደት ይሁንልህ! (Happy Birthday to you!)

title: Happy New Year
example: ለአንተ እና ለቤተሰብህ መልካም አዲስ ዓመት! (Happy New Year to you and your family!)

title: Get well soon
example: እግዚአብሔር ምህረቱን ያውርድልህ (May God send you healing / Get well soon)

title: Call me
somali: I soo telefon garee / I soo wac
example: ወደ ቤት ስትደርስ ደውልልኝ (Call me when you reach home)

title: Wait a minute
example: እባክህ አንድ አፍታ ቆይ፣ አሁን እመጣለሁ (Please wait a minute, I will come now)

title: Hurry up
example: ፍጠን፣ ረፈደብን! (Hurry up, we are late!)

title: Slow down
example: እባክህ ቀስ በል፣ አትፍጠን (Please slow down, don't rush)

title: Come in
example: በሩ ክፍት ነው፣ ግባ (The door is open, come in)

title: Go out
example: ከክፍሉ ውጣ (Go out of the room)

title: Sit down
example: እባክህ እዚህ ተቀመጥ (Please sit down here)

title: Stand up
example: ከወንበሩ ተነሳ (Stand up from the chair)

title: Don't worry
example: አትጨነቅ፣ ሁሉ ነገር ይሰካል (Don't worry, everything will be fine)

title: Don't fear / Don't be afraid
example: እኔ ከእኔ ጋር ነኝ፣ አትፍራ (I am with you, don't be afraid)

title: I am ready
example: አሁን ለመሄድ ተዘጋጅቻለሁ (Now I am ready to go)

title: I am busy
example: አሁን ስራ ላይ ነኝ፣ በኋላ እንደውውል (I am busy now, let's call later)

title: I am free / available
somali: Waan xor ahay / Waqti baan leeyahay
example: ዛሬ ምሽት ትርፍ ጊዜ አለኝ (I am free tonight)

title: I am sick
example: ዛሬ ታምሜአለሁ፣ ወደ ህክምና እሄዳለሁ (I am sick today, I am going to the doctor)

title: Take care
example: ደህና ሁን፣ ራስህን ተጠንቀቅ (Goodbye, take care of yourself)

title: Call a doctor
example: እባክህ በፍጥነት ሐኪም ጥሩ! (Please call a doctor quickly!)

title: Call an ambulance
example: አደጋ ደርሷል፣ አምቡላንስ ጥሩ! (An accident happened, call an ambulance!)

title: Call the police
example: በፍጥነት ፖሊስ ጥሩ! (Call the police quickly!)

title: I am lost
example: እባክህ እርዳኝ፣ መንገድ ጠፋብኝ (Please help me, I am lost)

title: Where is the hotel?
example: እባክህ ንገረኝ፣ ሆቴሉ የት ነው? (Please tell me, where is the hotel?)

title: Where is the restaurant?
example: ምግብ ቤቱ የት እንደሆነ ታውቃለህ? (Do you know where the restaurant is?)

title: Where is the bathroom?
example: እባክህ፣ መጸዳጃ ቤቱ የት ነው? (Excuse me, where is the bathroom?)

title: Where is the market?
example: ትልቁ ገበያ የት ነው? (Where is the big market?)

title: Where is the hospital?
example: በአቅራቢያው ሆስፒታል አለ? (Is there a hospital nearby?)

title: Where is the pharmacy?
example: መድኃኒት መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ፣ መድኃኒት ቤቱ የት ነው? (I want to buy medicine, where is the pharmacy?)

title: Where is the bank?
example: ገንዘብ ለመቀየር ባንክ እፈልጋለሁ፣ ባንኩ የት ነው? (I need a bank to exchange money, where is the bank?)

title: Where is the airport?
example: ከዚህ እስከ ኤርፖርት ምን ያህል ሩቅ ነው? (How far is it from here to the airport?)

title: Turn right
somali: U leexo xagga kooda / Midig u leexo
example: በመጀመሪያው መንገድ ወደ ቀኝ ታጠፍ (Turn right at the first street)

title: Turn left
example: ከመብራቱ በኋላ ወደ ግራ ታጠፍ (Turn left after the traffic light)

title: Go straight ahead
example: መንገዱን ተከተልና ቀጥተህ ሂድ (Follow the road and go straight ahead)

title: Stop here
example: እባክህ እዚህ ጋር ቁም፣ ወርዳለሁ (Please stop here, I will get off)

title: It is near
example: እግረ መንገድ ነው፣ በጣም ቅርብ ነው (It's on the way, it is very near)

title: It is far
example: ቦታው ሩቅ ስለሆነ ታክሲ ያስፈልጋል (Because the place is far, a taxi is needed)

title: It is open
example: ሱቁ አሁን ክፍት ነው (The shop is open now)

title: It is closed
example: ባንኩ ዛሬ ዝጉ ነው (The bank is closed today)

title: It is expensive
example: ይህ ልብስ በጣም ውድ ነው (This cloth is very expensive)

title: It is cheap
example: እዚህ ገበያ ላይ እቃ ርካሽ ነው (Goods are cheap at this market)

title: Reduce the price
example: በጣም ውድ ነው፣ እባክህ ዋጋ ቀንስልኝ (It is very expensive, please reduce the price)

title: I will buy it
example: ዋጋው ጥሩ ነው፣ እገዛዋለሁ (The price is good, I will buy it)

title: I want to pay
example: ሂሳቡን መክፈል እፈልጋለሁ (I want to pay the bill)

title: Give me the receipt
example: ከከፈልኩ በኋላ ደረሰኝ ስጠኝ (Give me the receipt after I pay)

title: Where is the receipt?
example: እባክህ ደረሰኙ የት ነው? (Where is the receipt, please?)

title: Keep the change
example: አመሰግናለሁ፣ መልሱን ያዘው (Thank you, keep the change)

title: I need water
example: ተጠምቻለሁ፣ ውሃ ያስፈልገኛል (I am thirsty, I need water)

title: I need food
example: ርቦኛል፣ ምግብ ያስፈልገኛል (I am hungry, I need food)

title: The food is delicious
somali: Cuntadu waa maa xammal / Waa xalwo
example: አመሰግናለሁ፣ ምግቡ በጣም ይጣፍጣል (Thank you, the food is delicious)

title: Check, please / Bill, please
example: በልተን ጨርሰናል፣ ሂሳብ አምጣልኝ (We have finished eating, bring the bill please)

title: Where is the Wi-Fi?
example: እዚህ ሆቴል ውስጥ ዋይፋይ አለ? (Is there Wi-Fi in this hotel?)

title: What is the Wi-Fi password?
example: እባክህ ንገረኝ፣ የዋይፋይ ፓስወርድ ምንድን ነው? (Please tell me, what is the Wi-Fi password?)

title: Can I take a photo?
example: እዚህ ቦታ ላይ ፎቶ ማንሳት እችላለሁ? (Can I take a photo at this place?)

title: Take a photo of us, please
somali: Fadlan sawir iga qaad / Na sawir
english: Take a photo of us, please
example: እባክህ ፎቶ አንሳልን፣ ካሜራው እዚህ አለ (Please take a photo of us, the camera is here)

title: I am looking for...
example: እኔ ሆቴል እየፈለግኩ ነው (I am looking for a hotel)

title: See you soon
example: ደህና ሁን፣ በቅርብ እንገናኛለን (Goodbye, see you soon)

title: At the market
example: ይህ ውታች በእንደት ነው? ሓማሳ ብር 50 ነው (How much is this? It is 50 birr)

title: Greeting at a restaurant
example: ሰላም፣ እንዴት ኖት? እንኳን ደህና መጡ (Hello, how are you? Welcome)

title: Ordering food
example: እባክዎ ምንይድ አለዎት? ይህ ይሆናል (Please, what do you have? This exists)

title: Asking for the menu
somali: Fadlan miisaanka ama liiska cuntada i sii
example: እባክህ የምግብ ዝርዝሩን ስጠኝ፣ ማዘዝ እፈልጋለሁ (Please give me the menu, I want to order)

title: I would like to order
example: ዝግጁ ነኝ፣ ማዘዝ እፈልጋለሁ (I am ready, I would like to order)

title: What do you recommend?
example: እዚህ ቤት ጥሩ ምግብ ምንድን ነው? ምን ትመክረኛለህ? (What is good food here? What do you recommend?)

title: A table for two, please
example: ሰላም፣ የሁለት ሰው ወንበር እባክህ (Hello, a table for two, please)

title: Where is the manager?
example: እባክህ ማነጋገር እፈልጋለሁ፣ ሥራ አስኪያጁ የት ነው? (Excuse me I want to talk, where is the manager?)

title: Is this spicy?
example: ይህ ምግብ በጣም ያቃጥላል? (Is this food very spicy?)

title: Without pepper, please
example: ምግቡን ሲያዘጋጁ ያለ በርበሬ እባክህ (When preparing the food, without pepper please)

title: Bring me coffee
example: ከምግብ በኋላ ቡና አምጣልኝ (Bring me coffee after the meal)

title: Bring me tea with milk
somali: Shaah caano leh i soo sii
example: እባክህ ጠዋት የወተት ሻይ አምጣልኝ (Please bring me tea with milk in the morning)

quizQuestions.prompt: Shaah caano leh i soo sii

title: Where is my order?
example: ቆየሁ እኮ፣ ያዘዝኩት የት ደረሰ? (I've been waiting long, where is my order?)

title: This is cold
example: እባክህ አሙቅልኝ፣ ይህ ቀዝቅዟል (Please heat it up for me, this is cold)

title: Can I have more water?
somali: Biyo dheeraad ah ma heli karaa?
example: እባክህ፣ ተጨማሪ ውሃ ማግኘት እችላለሁ? (Excuse me, can I have more water?)

quizQuestions.prompt: Biyo dheeraad ah ma heli karaa?

title: Can we split the bill?
example: ለየብቻችን ሂሳብ ከፍለን መክፈል እንችላለን? (Can we split the bill separately?)

title: Do you accept credit cards?
example: እባክህ፣ እዚህ በጥሬ ገንዘብ ወይስ በካርድ መክፈል ይቻላል? (Excuse me, can I pay with cash or card here?)

title: I am vegetarian
somali: Cunto hเนื้อ/hilib ah ma cuno / Khudrad oo kaliya baan cunaa
example: እኔ የሥጋ ምግብ አልበላም፣ የትክልት ምግብ አለ? (I don't eat meat, is there vegetarian food?)

title: Pack this for me
example: አልጨረስኩም፣ እባክህ ይህንን እሸግልኝ (I didn't finish, please pack this for me)

title: This is not what I ordered
english: This is not what I ordered
example: ይቅርታ፣ ይህ ያዘዝኩት አይደለም (Excuse me, this is not what I ordered)

title: Thank you for the service
example: በጣም ጥሩ ነበር፣ ስለ አገልግሎቱ አመሰግናለሁ (It was very good, thank you for the service)

title: Where can I find a taxi?
english: Where can I find a taxi?
example: ይቅርታ፣ ታክሲ የት ማግኘት እችላለሁ? (Excuse me, where can I find a taxi?)

title: How much to go to...?
english: How much is it to go to...?
example: ወደ ኤርፖርት ለመሄድ ስንት ነው? (How much is it to go to the airport?)

title: Please take me to this address
english: Please take me to this address
example: አድራሻው እዚህ አለ፣ እባክህ ወደዚህ አድራሻ ውሰደኝ (The address is here, please take me to this address)

title: Stop here, please
example: ደረስን፣ እዚህ አቁምልኝ እባክህ (We arrived, stop here please)

title: Is it far from here?
example: በእግር መሄድ እችላለሁ? ከዚህ ሩቅ ነው? (Can I walk? Is it far from here?)

title: Turn right / Turn left
amharic: ወደ ቀኝ ታጠፍ / ወደ ግራ ታጠፍ
pronunciation: wede kegn tatef / wede gira tatef
somali: Midig u leexo / Bidix u leexo
example: በመቀጠል ወደ ቀኝ ታጠፍ (Next, turn right)

title: Go straight ahead
example: መንገዱን ይዘህ ቀጥተህ ሂድ (Follow the road and go straight ahead)

title: Where is the bus station?
example: ይቅርታ፣ የአውቶቡስ ማቆሚያው የት ነው? (Excuse me, where is the bus station?)

title: Do you have a room available?
english: Do you have a room available?
example: ለአንድ ሌሊት ክፍት ክፍል አለ? (Is there a room available for one night?)

title: How much is one night?
example: የክፍሉ ዋጋ ለአንድ ሌሊት ስንት ነው? (How much is the room price for one night?)

title: I want to check in
english: I want to check in / reserve a room
example: ሰላም፣ ክፍል ለመያዝ እፈልጋለሁ (Hello, I want to check in / reserve a room)

title: Can I see the room?
example: ከመክፈሌ በፊት ክፍሉን ማየት እችላለሁ? (Can I see the room before paying?)

title: Where is the key?
example: የክፍሌ ቁልፍ የት ነው? (Where is the key to my room?)

title: The hot water is not working
english: The hot water is not working
example: በመታጠቢያ ቤት ውስጥ ትኩስ ውሃ አይሰራም (The hot water in the bathroom is not working)

title: What time is checkout?
example: እባክህ ነገ የመውጫ ሰዓት ስንት ነው? (Please what time is checkout tomorrow?)

title: I need help
example: እባክህ እርዳኝ፣ እርዳታ እፈልጋለሁ (Please help me, I need help)

title: Call a doctor, please
example: ታምሜአለሁ፣ እባክህ ሐኪም ጥሩልኝ (I am sick, call a doctor please)

title: Where is the pharmacy?
example: መድኃኒት መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ፣ መድኃኒት ቤት የት ነው? (I want to buy medicine, where is the pharmacy?)

title: I lost my bag
somali: Boorsadaydii ayaa iga lost-gawday / iga lumay
example: እባክህ እርዳኝ፣ ቦርሳዬ ጠፋብኝ (Please help me, I lost my bag)

title: Where is the police station?
example: ይቅርታ፣ ፖሊስ ጣቢያው የት ነው? (Excuse me, where is the police station?)

title: Where is the nearest bank?
somali: Bangiga ugu dhow xaggee ka helaa?
example: ገንዘብ መንዘር እፈልጋለሁ፣ የቅርብ ባንክ የት ይገኛል? (I want to exchange money, where is the nearest bank?)

quizQuestions.prompt: Bangiga ugu dhow xaggee ka helaa?

title: Where is the ATM?
example: ገንዘብ ለማውጣት ኤቲኤም የት አለ? (Where is an ATM to withdraw money?)

title: I want to buy a SIM card
somali: Waxaan rabbaa inaan iibsado kaardka talefoonka
english: I want to buy a SIM card
example: ሰላም፣ አዲስ የስልክ ካርድ መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ (Hello, I want to buy a new SIM card)

quizQuestions.prompt: Waxaan rabbaa inaan iibsado kaardka talefoonka

title: What is the Wi-Fi password?
example: እባክህ፣ የዋይፋይ የይለፍ ቃል ምንድን ነው? (Excuse me, what is the Wi-Fi password?)

title: Where can I charge my phone?
english: Where can I charge my phone?
example: ባታሪው አልቋል፣ ስልኬን የት መሙላት እችላለሁ? (The battery is finished, where can I charge my phone?)

title: Can I use your phone?
example: አስቸኳይ ጥሪ ነው፣ ስልክህን መጠቀም እችላለሁ? (It's an urgent call, can I use your phone?)

title: What time does it open/close?
somali: Meeqa saac ayaa la furaa / la xidhaa?
english: What time does it open / close?
example: ሱቁ ነገ ስንት ሰዓት ይከፈታል? (What time does the shop open tomorrow?)

title: Is it open today?
example: ቤተ መጻሕፍቱ ዛሬ ክፍት ነው? (Is the library open today?)

title: How much does this cost?
example: ይቅርታ፣ ይህ ዋጋው ስንት ነው? (Excuse me, how much does this cost?)

title: That is too expensive
somali: Aad buu u qali ah yahay
example: አይ፣ ይህ በጣም ውድ ነው፣ ቀንስልኝ (No, that is too expensive, lower it for me)

quizQuestions.prompt: Aad buu u qali ah yahay

title: Can you lower the price?
example: ውድ ነው፣ እባክህ ትንሽ ቅናሽ ታደርግልኛለህ? (It's expensive, please can you lower the price a bit?)

title: I am just looking
somali: Daawasho oo kaliya baan u socdaa
example: አልገዛም፣ ለማየት / ለመመልከት ያህል ነው (I'm not buying, I am just looking)

quizQuestions.prompt: Daawasho oo kaliya baan u socdaa

title: I'll take this one
example: አመርጦኛል፣ ይህንን እወስዳለሁ (I liked it, I'll take this one)

title: Do you have a bigger/smaller size?
somali: Size ka weyn / ka yar ma leedahay?
english: Do you have a bigger / smaller size?
example: ይህ አልበቃኝም፣ ትልቅ መጠን አለ? (This doesn't fit me, do you have a bigger size?)

title: Do you have another color?
example: ጥቁሩን አልወደድኩትም፣ ሌላ ቀለም አለ? (I didn't like the black one, do you have another color?)

title: Where is the fitting room?
example: ልብሱን ልለካው ነበር፣ መልኪያ ክፍሉ የት ነው? (I wanted to try the clothes on, where is the fitting room?)

title: Can I exchange this?
example: ልኩ አልሆነኝም፣ ይህንን መቀየር እችላለሁ? (It wasn't my size, can I exchange this?)

title: Give me a receipt, please
example: ከከፈልኩ በኋላ ደረሰኝ ስጠኝ እባክህ (After I pay, give me a receipt please)

title: Where is the bathroom?
example: ይቅርታ፣ መጸዳጃ ቤቱ የት ነው? (Excuse me, where is the bathroom?)

title: Have a good day!
example: ስለ እርዳታው አመሰግናለሁ፣ መልካም ቀን! (Thank you for the help, have a good day!)

title: Nice to meet you
example: ስሜ አህመድ ይባላል፣ ስላወቅኩህ ደስ ብሎኛል (My name is Ahmed, nice to meet you)

title: What is your name?
example: ሰላም፣ ስምህ ማን ነው? (Hello, what is your name?)

title: Where are you from?
example: እኔ ከሶማሊያ ነኝ፣ አንተ ከየት ነህ? (I am from Somalia, where are you from?)

title: I don't speak Amharic well
somali: Af-Amxaariga si fiican u ma khadlaayo
example: ይቅርታ፣ እኔ አማርኛ በጥሩ አልናገርም (Sorry, I don't speak Amharic well)

quizQuestions.prompt: Af-Amxaariga si fiican u ma khadlaayo

title: Do you speak English?
example: እባክህ፣ እንግሊዝኛ ትናገራለህ? (Please, do you speak English?)

title: Please speak slowly
example: አልገባኝም፣ እባክህ በዝግታ ተናገር (I didn't understand, please speak slowly)

title: Could you repeat that?
example: አልሰማሁህም፣ እባክህ ድገምልኝ (I didn't hear you, please repeat that for me)

title: I understand / I don't understand
example: አሁን ገብቶኛል፣ አመሰግናለሁ (Now I understand, thank you)

title: Can you write it down?
example: ስልክ ቁጥሩን እባክህ ጻፍልኝ (Please write down the phone number for me)

title: What does this mean?
example: ይቅርታ፣ ይህ ቃል ማለት ምን ማለት ነው? (Excuse me, what does this word mean?)

title: Where are you going?
example: ሰላም፣ ወዴት እየሄድክ ነው? (Hello, where are you going?)

title: What are you doing?
example: አሁን አትርፍ ነህ? ምን እያደረግክ ነው? (Are you free now? What are you doing?)

title: Are you busy?
example: አሁን ሥራ ላይ ነህ ወይስ ትችላለህ? (Are you busy now or are you free?)

title: I am free today
example: ዛሬ ሥራ የለኝም፣ ነፃ ነኝ (I don't have work today, I am free)

title: See you later
example: አሁን መሄድ አለብኝ፣ በኋላ እንገናኛለን (I must go now, see you later)

title: See you tomorrow
example: መልካም ምሽት፣ ነገ እንገናኛለን (Good evening, see you tomorrow)

title: Safe journey / Bon voyage
english: Safe journey / Have a good trip
example: ደህና ሂድ፣ መልካም መንገድ! (Go safely, have a good trip!)

title: Congratulations!
example: ስራ ስላገኘህ እንኳን ደስ አለህ! (Congratulations on getting the job!)

title: Good luck!
example: ለፈተናው መልካም እድል! (Good luck for the exam!)

title: Get well soon
example: ስለታመምክ አዝኛለሁ፣ ምህረቱን ያውርድልህ (I'm sorry you are sick, get well soon)

title: Where can I find a pharmacy?
english: Where can I find a pharmacy?
example: መድኃኒት መግዛት እፈልጋለሁ፣ መድኃኒት ቤት የት ማግኘት እችላለሁ? (I want to buy medicine, where can I find a pharmacy?)

title: I need a doctor
example: በጣም አምሞኛል፣ ሐኪም እፈልጋለሁ (I am very sick, I need a doctor)

title: My head hurts / I have a headache
english: My head hurts / I have a headache
example: ዛሬ በጣም ራሴን ያመኛል (My head hurts a lot today)

title: My stomach hurts
example: ምግብ ከበላሁ በኋላ ሆዴን አሞኛል (After I ate food, my stomach hurt)

title: Call an ambulance!
example: አደጋ ደርሷል፣ እባካችሁ አምቡላንስ ጥሩ! (An accident occurred, please call an ambulance!)

title: I am lost
somali: Jidka baan ka lumay / Waan lumay
example: ይቅርታ፣ መንገድ ጠፍቶብኛል፣ ሆቴሉ የት ነው? (Excuse me, I am lost, where is the hotel?)

title: Call the police!
example: ስርቆት ተፈጽሟል፣ ፍጥነው ፖሊስ ጥሩ! (A theft happened, call the police quickly!)

title: I lost my bag
example: ታክሲ ውስጥ ቦርሳዬ ጠፋብኝ (I lost my bag inside the taxi)

title: I lost my passport
example: ኤምባሲ መሄድ አለብኝ፣ ፓስፖርቴ ጠፋብኝ (I need to go to the embassy, I lost my passport)

title: Be careful!
example: መንገዱ ተንሸራታች ነው፣ ተጠንቀቅ! (The road is slippery, be careful!)

title: Don't worry
somali: Huurin ma laha / Huurka ha qaban
example: ሁሉ ነገር መልካም ይሆናል፣ አትጨነቅ (Everything will be fine, don't worry)

title: What happened?
example: ሰዎች ተሰብስበዋል፣ ምን ተፈጠረ? (People are gathered, what happened?)

title: It's not a problem / No problem
english: It's not a problem / No problem
example: ስለዘገየህ ችግር የለውም (No problem that you were late)

title: I agree
example: ሐሳብህ ጥሩ ነው፣ እኔም እስማማለሁ (Your idea is good, I agree too)

title: I disagree
example: ይቅርታ፣ በዚህ ሐሳብ ላይ አልስማማም (Sorry, I disagree with this idea)

title: What do you think?
example: ስለዚህ ጉዳይ ምን ይመስልሃል? (What do you think about this matter?)

title: I am ready
example: ለመሄድ ዝግጁ ነኝ፣ እንሂድ (I am ready to go, let's go)

title: Wait a minute
example: አንድ አፍታ ጠብቅ፣ አሁን እመጣለሁ (Wait a minute, I am coming now)

title: Let's go
example: ጊዜው አልቋል፣ አሁን እንሂድ (Time is up, let's go now)

title: Welcome / You're welcome
example: ወደ ቤታችን እንኳን ደህና መጣህ! (Welcome to our house!)

title: Present tense: to be
example: እሱ መምህር ነው (He is a teacher)

title: Personal Pronoun: I
example: እኔ ተማሪ ነኝ (I am a student)

title: Personal Pronoun: You (m/f)
example: አንተ ደግ ነህ (You are kind)

title: Personal Pronoun: He / She
example: እሷ ጥሩ ሰው ናት (She is a good person)

title: Personal Pronoun: We
example: እኛ ጓደኞች ነን (We are friends)

title: Personal Pronoun: They
example: እነሱ እዚህ ናቸው (They are here)

title: Possessive: My
example: ይህ መጽሐፌ ነው (This is my book)

title: Possessive: Your
example: ስምህ ማን ነው? (What is your name?)

title: Possessive: His / Her
example: ቤቱ ትልቅ ነው (His house is big)

title: Demonstrative: This (m/f)
example: ይህ ወንድሜ ነው (This is my brother)

title: Demonstrative: That (m/f)
example: ያ ቤት አዲስ ነው (That house is new)

title: Demonstrative Plural: These / Those
example: እነዚህ መጻሕፍት የእኔ ናቸው (These books are mine)

title: Question Word: What
example: ምን ይፈልጋሉ? (What do you want?)

title: Question Word: Who
example: ይህ ሰው ማን ነው? (Who is this person?)

title: Question Word: Where
example: ትምህርት ቤቱ የት ነው? (Where is the school?)

title: Question Word: When
example: መቼ ትመጣለህ? (When will you come?)

title: Question Word: Why
example: ለምን አረፈድክ? (Why were you late?)

title: Question Word: How
example: እንዴት ነህ? (How are you?)

title: Question Word: How much / How many
example: ይህ ዋጋው ስንት ነው? (How much is this?)

title: Negation: Not / No
example: እሱ መምህር አይደለም (He is not a teacher)

title: Past tense: to be (was/were)
example: እሱ ትናንት እዚህ ነበረ (He was here yesterday)

title: Future Marker: Will / Shall
somali: Waa inuu ahaado / Waad noqon doontaa
example: ነገ እመጣለሁ (I will come tomorrow)

title: Preposition: In / Inside
example: መጽሐፉ ቦርሳ ውስጥ ነው (The book is inside the bag)

title: Preposition: On / Above
example: ስልኩ ጤረጴዛው ላይ ነው (The phone is on the table)

title: Preposition: Under / Below
example: ድመቷ ከአልጋው ስር ናት (The cat is under the bed)

title: Preposition: Near / Beside
example: ከእኔ አጠገብ ተቀመጥ (Sit next to me)

title: Preposition: Far from
example: ቤቱ ከእዚህ ሩቅ ነው (The house is far from here)

title: Preposition: Before
example: ከመብላትህ በፊት እጅህን ታጠብ (Wash your hands before eating)

title: Preposition: After
example: ከሥራ በኋላ እንገናኝ (Let's meet after work)

title: Conjunction: And
example: አሊ እና ሀሰን መጡ (Ali and Hassan came)

title: Conjunction: Or
example: ቡና ወይም ሻይ ትፈልጋለህ? (Do you want coffee or tea?)

title: Conjunction: But
example: ደክሞኛል ግን እሰራለሁ (I am tired, but I will work)

title: Conjunction: Because
example: አልመጣሁም ምክንያቱም ታምሜ ነበር (I didn't come because I was sick)

title: Conjunction: If
example: ጊዜ ካለህ ነይ (If you have time, come)

title: Modal Verb: Can / Able to
example: አማርኛ መናገር እችላለሁ (I can speak Amharic)

title: Modal Verb: Cannot / Unable to
example: ዛሬ መምጣት አልችልም (I cannot come today)

title: Modal Verb: Must / Have to
example: አሁን መሄድ አለብኝ (I must go now)

title: Modal Verb: Want / Desire
example: ውሃ መጠጣት እፈልጋለሁ (I want to drink water)

title: Modal Verb: Need
example: እርዳታ ያስፈልገኛል (I need help)

title: Verb: To Have
english: To have (I have / You have / She has)
example: አንድ መኪና አለኝ (I have a car)

title: Verb: To Not Have
english: To not have (I don't have / You don't have)
example: ገንዘብ የለኝም (I don't have money)

title: Imperative: Come / Go
example: ወደ እዚህ ና፣ ከዚያ ሂድ (Come here, go there)

title: Imperative: Eat / Drink
example: ምግብ ብላ፣ ውሃ ጠጣ (Eat food, drink water)

title: Imperative Negative: Don't do
example: ይህን አታድርግ! (Don't do this!)

title: Adverb: Always
example: እሱ ሁልጊዜ ጠዋት ይነሳል (He always wakes up early in the morning)

title: Adverb: Never
example: እኔ በፍጹም ውሸት አልናገርም (I never lie)

title: Adverb: Sometimes
example: አንዳንዴ ወደ ፓርክ እሄዳለሁ (Sometimes I go to the park)

title: Adverb: Usually / Often
example: እሱ ብዙ ጊዜ መጽሐፍ ያንበባል (He usually reads books)

title: Adverb: Quickly / Fast
example: በፍጥነት ሂድ! (Go quickly!)

title: Adverb: Slowly
example: ቀስ ብለህ ተናገር (Speak slowly)

title: Adverb: Very / Much
example: ይህ ምግብ በጣም ጥሩ ነው (This food is very good)

title: Adverb: A little
example: ጥቂት አማርኛ እናገራለሁ (I speak a little Amharic)

title: Adverb: Also / Too
example: እኔም እመጣለሁ (I am also coming)

title: Adverb: Only
example: አንድ መጽሐፍ ብቻ አለኝ (I have only one book)

title: Comparative: More than
example: ይህ ከዚያ ይበልጣል (This is more than that)

title: Superlative: Most / -est
example: እሱ ከሁሉም የሚበልጥ ተማሪ ነው (He is the best student)

title: Particle: With (accompaniment)
example: ከጓደኛዬ ጋር እሄዳለሁ (I am going with my friend)

title: Particle: Without
example: ያለ ስኳር ሻይ እጠጣለሁ (I drink tea without sugar)

title: Particle: For
example: ይህ ስጦታ ለአንተ ነው (This gift is for you)

title: Particle: From
example: ከቤት መጣሁ (I came from home)
